[!dolt] skip
# Test bd ready excludes blocked work
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'Ready issue' --description 'Can be worked now' --json
extractid READY
bd create 'Blocking issue' --description 'Dependency root' --json
extractid BLOCKER
bd create 'Blocked issue' --description 'Must wait' --json
extractid BLOCKED
bd dep add $BLOCKED $BLOCKER

bd ready
stdout 'Ready issue'
stdout 'Blocking issue'
! stdout 'Blocked issue'
